id.description: The unique identifier for the project.

name.description: The unique name for the project.

appName.description: The display name of the application, shown to end users during the connection flow.

orgId.description: The ID of the organization that this project belongs to.

createTime.description: The time the project was created.

updateTime.description: The time the project was updated.

entitlements.description: Plan-based feature flags for the project. These are managed by Ampersand and cannot be set via the API.

brandingRemoval.description: Controls whether Ampersand branding is removed from the embeddable UI components.

value.description: True if Ampersand branding has been removed for this project.
